Guideline: No theme attrs inside drawable/color XML
Description: Android 15 passes theme=null to children of StateListDrawable/LayerListDrawable, so ?android:attr references nested in selectors crash inflation at startup (Android 14 tolerated them via a fallback theme)
Do: Use literal colors from values/ + values-night (e.g. @color/overlay_highlight); replace ?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless with a nested <ripple> with a white mask

Description: Every color used by day/night UI lives in values/colors.xml AND values-night/colors.xml with the same name
Do: Define the color twice (day value in values/; night value in values-night/)
Don't: Rely on ?android:attr/theme indirection to adapt automatically

Description: Every UI restyle must be rendered with uiMode night before shipping (cmd uimode night yes on emulator)
Do: Screenshot day AND night on an emulator before tagging a release
Don't: Ship a restyle validated only in light mode
Code Good: adb shell cmd uimode night yes; open screen; screencap

Guideline: Smoke on the newest shipping API
Description: Add an instrumentation smoke that saves real config and launches the main Activity on the newest API your targetSdk reaches (Android 15 = API 35)
Do: Instrumentation test (am instrument) on AVD at API >= targetSdk; process alive + crash buffer empty = green
Don't: Only test on an older API where inflation bugs are tolerated
Code Good: Launch MainActivity on an API 35 AVD with a real saved config (am instrument), sleep, assert process alive and empty crash buffer

Description: Apps targeting SDK 35 on Android 15 get forced edge-to-edge; status/navigation bars overlay content
Do: Apply insets via ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener / WindowInsetsCompat type system bars
Don't: Assume fitsSystemWindows centers content like pre-35

Description: Before any release tag after a res/ change: grep for theme attribute references in drawables and color selectors and fail if non-empty (strip XML comments first)
Do: Strip XML comments then grep, e.g. perl -0777 -pe 's/<!--.*?-->//gs' f.xml | grep -c '?attr' over app/src/main/res/drawable and app/src/main/res/color; must be 0
Don't: Tag a release with theme attrs left in nested drawable XML
Code Good: Clean literal colors; gate script exits 0

Description: Content that opens by edge swipe must provide a visible grabber/tap target; on Android 15 gesture nav the system back gesture eats edge swipes at x < ~20dp
Do: Place the grabber strip inside the gesture exclusion zone; also support tap-open
Don't: Assume users can open a right-edge drawer by swiping from the very edge (back gesture wins)
Code Good: 28dp chevron strip + drawer open on tap

Guideline: Nested drawable children must inflate without a theme
Description: Drawable children inflated via selector/layer-list get theme=null on Android 15: only shapes, ripples, bitmaps and gradients with literal colors inflate reliably
Do: Keep nested children literal; set tints in code (app:tint with a literal color resource) when theme-awareness is needed
